title: GUIDE: Governed Unified Intelligence for Document-to-Artifact Generation in Enterprise Settings
abstract: arXiv:2608.12133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise guideline documents are heterogeneous and multimodal, combining narrative text, complex tables, and embedded images. Existing LLM and VLM systems face hallucinated content, table structure degradation, and lack governed workflows extending beyond extraction to validation and artifact generation. This leaves enterprises to perform this manually, consuming 2-3 days per document. To address this, we introduce GUIDE, a governed multi-agent framework built on a shared versioned rule store with schema-validated inter-agent contracts and end-to-end provenance tracking. Six specialized agents handle parsing, VLM-driven extraction, consistency checking, evaluation, human-in-the-loop (HITL) escalation, and persona-tailored artifact synthesis. translated_title: GUIDE：企业环境中文档到工件生成的受治理统一智能框架
translated_abstract: 企业指导文档具有异构和多模态特性，结合了叙述性文本、复杂表格和嵌入图像。现有的LLM和VLM系统存在幻觉内容、表格结构退化以及缺乏超越提取到验证和工件生成的受治理工作流的问题。这导致企业不得不手动执行这些任务，每份文档耗时2-3天。为解决这一问题，我们引入了GUIDE，一个基于共享版本化规则存储的受治理多智能体框架，具有模式验证的智能体间契约和端到端溯源追踪。六个专门智能体负责解析、VLM驱动的提取、一致性检查、评估、人工介入（HITL）升级和个性化工件合成。在120份真实企业指导文档上的评估中，GUIDE实现了96%的文档成功率，提取了3,896条规则，其中71.4%自动批准，生成了812个部署就绪工件，并减少了...
tldr: GUIDE通过受治理的多智能体框架和版本化规则存储，实现了企业文档从提取到验证再到工件生成的自动化，显著提升了效率和准确性。
en_tdlr: GUIDE enables automated document-to-artifact generation in enterprises through a governed multi-agent framework with versioned rule storage, significantly improving efficiency and accuracy.
